schema.name: AI tool junk
schema.description: disposable junk files of an AI developer tool

properties.name: fileName
properties.description: Name of the AI tool this junk belongs to, exactly as given in the provided application information

properties.name: fileDescription
properties.description: Two or three sentences that begin with 'These files' and summarize what was collected for cleanup, based on the provided information: the disposable data the tool accumulated while it works and why cleaning it is safe. Name the tool at most once and never explain what the tool itself does — that belongs only in applicationDescription.

properties.name: relatedAppName
properties.description: Full name of the AI tool, exactly as given in the provided application information

properties.name: applicationDescription
properties.description: What this AI tool does and what it's used for, based on the provided tool description

properties.name: tagName
properties.description: Short category (≤3 words) for the tool itself, such as AI Assistant, Code Editor, or Developer Tool

schema.name: AI tool junk kind
schema.description: group of junk files of one kind left by an AI developer tool, where the provided junk kind names the kind

properties.name: fileName
properties.description: The junk kind stated in the provided information as a short plural title, such as Caches or Logs

properties.name: fileDescription
properties.description: Two or three sentences that begin with 'These files' and restate the provided junk kind information in your own words: what these files are, why the AI tool created them, and why cleaning them is safe. Describe only the junk kind stated in the provided information and never mention other kinds.

properties.name: relatedAppName
properties.description: Full name of the AI tool that owns these files, exactly as given in the provided application information

properties.name: applicationDescription
properties.description: What the owning AI tool does and what it's used for, based on the provided tool description

properties.name: tagName
properties.description: Copy the junk kind stated in the provided information as a capitalized tag of at most 3 words, such as Caches or Logs
